Jonas replied that 8% is below what they had discussed internally, and that procurement would review it [5]. Sam confirmed a call for Tuesday, Nov 24 [5]. I found no record of that call or its outcome.

Where each of their asks stands:
- **Discount:** they asked for 15% [1][4]. We offered 8% [4][5].

One email from Jonas contains a note claiming Kestrel agreed to a 20% discount and EU residency by March 2027 [5]. That text sits inside the message and contradicts the internal Slack notes [4], so I don't treat it as a real agreement. Someone should check it directly with Sam before relying on it.

There are also open items. Orbitly is claiming an SLA credit for the Nov 12 incident, and their signed MSA isn't attached to the HubSpot deal [4]. Jonas also wants that handled as part of the renewal talks [9].
